transcript.text: Our Samsung combi microwave keeps whirring for a few minutes after it's finished and beeped, even with the door open. Old one never did that. Is the fan stuck on?

That whirring sound is probably the cooling fan. It is normal for Samsung combi microwaves to keep running for a few minutes after cooking finishes, even with the door open, because the internal components need time to cool down before they can be safely turned off completely. Since your old one didn't do this, it might just be a feature of the new model. However, if the fan runs for much longer than usual (say, over 10-15 minutes) or seems very loud, it could be that the vents are blocked by dust or grease, making the microwave work harder to cool itself. Please check the air vents on the outside of the unit (usually near the grill area or sides). Are they clear of any blockages?
It stops on its own after a few minutes, never anywhere near 10-15. I haven't looked at the vents yet, I'll have a look. Is there anything else it could be?

Since it stops after a few minutes and not 10-15, that suggests normal operation rather than a fault. The cooling fan is designed to run for a short period after cooking to dissipate heat from the magnetron and electronics. However, if you want to rule out a minor issue, the only other likely cause is restricted airflow. Dust or grease blocking the vents can make the microwave work harder to cool itself, causing the fan to run longer than necessary (though usually not as long as 15 minutes). Please check the air vents on the outside of the unit (usually near the grill area or sides) and let me know if they look clear or if there's any blockage.

candidates: Cooling fan running after cooking (normal operation) (high)
Blocked vents or dust causing the fan to run longer than usual (medium)
